title: One send history per person across nurture, campaigns and automatic emails, on the admin contact page

source.ref: Contact, funnel and tracking audit 2026-11-19 (project thread: Plan a permission-first contact system, report https://claude.ai/artifact/3sCikNdCHC9khmwCJbubfk)

detail: Wave 3 of the permission-first contact plan (finding 5: funnels, nurture and campaigns are separate systems, with no single place that shows what one person was sent or why). Work: a reader that merges outreach_sends, the nurture enrolment log, launch_email_log and the lifecycle cap reservations for one address, newest first, each with its reason and the stop link, rendered on the admin contact page. Read only, no migration expected. Filed 2026-11-20 by the verification sweep: the plan named this id but no row existed.

verify.note: Fails until the admin contact page renders a send history for the person.
